## Tools

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

library(scales)

## Data And Metrics

```{r}
# point to the folder with CSVs
folder <- here("..", "01-nem-data")
all_files <- list.files(folder, "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Keep only the latest export per region (based on leading YYYYMMDD in filename).
file_tbl <- tibble(file = all_files) %>%
  mutate(
    base = basename(file),
    file_date_chr = str_match(base, "^(\\d{8})\\s+")[, 2],
    file_date = ymd(file_date_chr),
    region_stub = tools::file_path_sans_ext(base) %>% str_remove("^\\d{8}\\s*"),
    mtime = as.POSIXct(file.info(file)$mtime)
  ) %>%
  group_by(region_stub) %>%
  arrange(desc(file_date), desc(mtime), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

files <- file_tbl$file

# region styling
state_cols <- c(
  "New South Wales"   = "#004EA2",
  "Queensland"        = "#7C0A02",
  "South Australia"   = "#E84E1B",
  "Tasmania"          = "#006A4D",
  "Victoria"          = "#8B008B",
  "Western Australia" = "#FFD700",
  "NEM"               = "black"
)
state_labels <- c(
  "New South Wales"   = "NSW",
  "Queensland"        = "QLD",
  "South Australia"   = "SA",
  "Tasmania"          = "TAS",
  "Victoria"          = "VIC",
  "Western Australia" = "WA",
  "NEM"               = "NEM"
)
alpha_vals <- set_names(c(rep(1, 6), 0.6), names(state_cols))
size_vals  <- set_names(c(rep(1, 6), 2   ), names(state_cols))

# abbreviations for regions
state_abbrev <- c(
  "New South Wales"   = "NSW",
  "Queensland"        = "QLD",
  "South Australia"   = "SA",
  "Tasmania"          = "TAS",
  "Victoria"          = "VIC",
  "Western Australia" = "WA",
  "NEM"               = "NEM"
)

# map colours to technologies
tech_cols <- c(
  "Coal (Brown)"           = "#8B4513",
  "Coal (Black)"           = "#000000",
  "Bioenergy (Biomass)"    = "#7F8C00",
  "Battery (Discharging)"  = "#8E24AA",
  "Distillate"             = "#C1440E",
  "Gas (Steam)"            = "#00A2E8",
  "Gas (CCGT)"             = "#FF7F27",
  "Gas (OCGT)"             = "#00B3B8",
  "Gas (Reciprocating)"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Gas (Waste Coal Mine)"  = "#A4A4A4",
  "Hydro"                  = "#0072B2",
  "Wind"                   = "#8CC63F",
  "Solar (Utility)"        = "orange",
  "Solar (Rooftop)"        = "#FFC20E"
)

# which technologies to include
tech_patterns <- c(
  "Coal \\(Brown\\)",
  "Coal \\(Black\\)",
  "Bioenergy \\(Biomass\\)",
  "Battery \\(Discharging\\)",
  "Distillate",
  "Gas \\(Steam\\)",
  "Gas \\(CCGT\\)",
  "Gas \\(OCGT\\)",
  "Gas \\(Reciprocating\\)",
  "Gas \\(Waste Coal Mine\\)",
  "Hydro",
  "Wind",
  "Solar \\(Utility\\)",
  "Solar \\(Rooftop\\)"
)

all_metrics <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cols <- names(df)

  region <- basename(file) |>
    tools::file_path_sans_ext() |>
    str_remove("^\\d{8}\\s*")

  date <- ymd(df[[1]])

  vw_col <- grep("^Volume Weighted Price - AUD/MWh$", cols, value = TRUE)
  vw_price <- if (length(vw_col) == 1) df[[vw_col]] else NA_real_

  wind_curt_col <- grep("^Wind \\(Curtailment\\) -\\s*GWh$", cols, value = TRUE)
  wind_curtailment <- if (length(wind_curt_col) == 1) df[[wind_curt_col]] else NA_real_

  solar_utility_curt_col <- grep("^Solar \\(Utility\\) \\(Curtailment\\) -\\s*GWh$", cols, value = TRUE)
  solar_utility_curtailment <- if (length(solar_utility_curt_col) == 1) df[[solar_utility_curt_col]] else NA_real_

  map_dfr(tech_patterns, function(pat) {
    energy_col <- grep(paste0("^", pat, " -.*GWh$"), cols, value = TRUE)
    value_col  <- grep(paste0("^", pat, ".*Market Value"), cols, value = TRUE)

    energy <- if (length(energy_col)) df[[energy_col]] else NA_real_
    value  <- if (length(value_col )) df[[value_col ]] else NA_real_
    source <- gsub("\\\\", "", pat)

    tibble(
      Region         = region,
      Date           = date,
      Source         = source,
      EnergyGWh      = as.numeric(energy),
      WindCurtailmentGWh = as.numeric(wind_curtailment),
      SolarUtilityCurtailmentGWh = as.numeric(solar_utility_curtailment),
      MarketValueAUD = as.numeric(value),
      VWPrice        = as.numeric(vw_price)
    )
  })
})

all_metrics <- all_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Region = recode(
      Region,
      "Open Electricity"         = "NEM",
      "Western Australia (SWIS)" = "Western Australia",
      .default                    = Region
    ),
    Region = factor(Region, levels = names(state_cols)),
    CapturePrice = MarketValueAUD / (EnergyGWh * 1e3),
    CapturePrice = if_else(is.finite(CapturePrice), CapturePrice, NA_real_)
  )

# Use OE volume-weighted price when available; otherwise fall back to an
# implied benchmark from aggregate market value / aggregate generation.
benchmark_prices <- all_metrics %>%
  group_by(Region, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    VWPriceAvailable = if (all(is.na(VWPrice))) NA_real_ else first(VWPrice[!is.na(VWPrice)]),
    ImpliedBenchmarkPrice = {
      total_value <- sum(MarketValueAUD, na.rm = TRUE)
      total_mwh <- sum(EnergyGWh, na.rm = TRUE) * 1e3
      if (is.finite(total_value) && is.finite(total_mwh) && total_mwh > 0) {
        total_value / total_mwh
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(BenchmarkPrice = coalesce(VWPriceAvailable, ImpliedBenchmarkPrice))

all_metrics <- all_metrics %>%
  left_join(benchmark_prices, by = c("Region", "Date")) %>%
  mutate(
    WindCurtailmentGWh = pmax(coalesce(WindCurtailmentGWh, 0), 0),
    SolarUtilityCurtailmentGWh = pmax(coalesce(SolarUtilityCurtailmentGWh, 0), 0)
  )

long_df_all <- all_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    EffectiveEnergyGWh_excluding = EnergyGWh,
    EffectiveEnergyGWh_including = case_when(
      Source == "Wind" ~ EnergyGWh + WindCurtailmentGWh,
      Source == "Solar (Utility)" ~ EnergyGWh + SolarUtilityCurtailmentGWh,
      .default = EnergyGWh
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(EffectiveEnergyGWh_excluding, EffectiveEnergyGWh_including),
    names_to = "Method",
    values_to = "EffectiveEnergyGWh"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(
      Method,
      "EffectiveEnergyGWh_excluding" = "excluding-curtailment",
      "EffectiveEnergyGWh_including" = "including-curtailment"
    ),
    CapturePrice = MarketValueAUD / (EffectiveEnergyGWh * 1e3),
    CapturePrice = if_else(is.finite(CapturePrice), CapturePrice, NA_real_),
    CaptureRatio = CapturePrice / BenchmarkPrice,
    CaptureRatio = if_else(is.finite(CaptureRatio), CaptureRatio, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Source %in% c("Battery (Charging)", "Pumps"))

out_dir <- here("..", "03-outputs")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

method_out_dirs <- c(
  "excluding-curtailment" = here("..", "03-outputs", "excluding-curtailment"),
  "including-curtailment" = here("..", "03-outputs", "including-curtailment")
)
purrr::walk(method_out_dirs, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

curtailment_caption <- "Note: Capture price calculations for wind and utility-scale solar include curtailed generation from August 2024."

base_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length  = unit(-4, "pt"),
    axis.title         = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text          = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.key.width   = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0)
  )
```

## Capture Price By Technology (Across Regions)

```{r}
for (method in names(method_out_dirs)) {
for (tech in sort(unique(long_df_all$Source))) {
  df <- long_df_all %>%
    filter(Method == method, Source == tech, !is.na(CapturePrice))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  x_min <- max(as.Date("2014-01-01"), min(df$Date, na.rm = TRUE))
  x_max <- max(df$Date, na.rm = TRUE)

  visible <- df %>%
    filter(Date >= x_min) %>%
    mutate(Region = droplevels(Region))

  y_br <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)(visible$CapturePrice)
  y_br <- y_br[y_br >= 0]
  y_labels_fn <- function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "", scales::comma(x))

  p <- ggplot(visible, aes(
      x = Date,
      y = CapturePrice,
      colour = Region,
      alpha = Region,
      size = Region
    )) +
    geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, key_glyph = draw_key_point) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = state_cols,
      labels = state_labels,
      name = NULL,
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 15, size = 5, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_vals, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_manual(values = size_vals, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max),
      breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), x_max, by = "1 year"),
      minor_breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), x_max, by = "3 months"),
      date_labels = "'%y",
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(y_br, na.rm = TRUE)),
      breaks = y_br,
      labels = y_labels_fn,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
      sec.axis = dup_axis(labels = y_labels_fn)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tech, " Capture Price"),
      subtitle = "Trailing 12-month window (from source export)",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Price ($/MWh)",
      caption = if_else(
        method == "including-curtailment" && tech %in% c("Wind", "Solar (Utility)"),
        curtailment_caption,
        NA_character_
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    base_theme

  print(p)
  ggsave(
    file.path(method_out_dirs[[method]], paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tech), ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
}
```

## Capture Ratio By Technology (Across Regions)

```{r}
for (method in names(method_out_dirs)) {
for (tech in sort(unique(long_df_all$Source))) {
  df <- long_df_all %>%
    filter(Method == method, Source == tech, !is.na(CaptureRatio))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  x_min <- max(as.Date("2014-01-01"), min(df$Date, na.rm = TRUE))
  x_max <- max(df$Date, na.rm = TRUE)

  y_min <- min(df$CaptureRatio, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(df$CaptureRatio, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lower <- min(-0.05, y_min * 1.1)
  y_upper <- max(1.0, y_max * 1.05)
  if (!is.finite(y_lower) || !is.finite(y_upper) || y_lower >= y_upper) {
    y_lower <- -0.05
    y_upper <- 1.5
  }

  visible <- df %>%
    filter(Date >= x_min) %>%
    mutate(Region = droplevels(Region))

  y_br <- scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)(visible$CaptureRatio)
  y_br <- y_br[y_br >= 0]

  p <- ggplot(visible, aes(
      x = Date,
      y = CaptureRatio,
      colour = Region,
      alpha = Region,
      size = Region
    )) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, key_glyph = draw_key_point) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = state_cols,
      labels = state_labels,
      name = NULL,
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(linetype = 0, shape = 15, size = 5, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_vals, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_manual(values = size_vals, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max),
      breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), x_max, by = "1 year"),
      minor_breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), x_max, by = "3 months"),
      date_labels = "'%y",
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      breaks = y_br,
      labels = scales::label_percent(),
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
      sec.axis = dup_axis(labels = scales::label_percent())
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tech, " Capture Ratio"),
      subtitle = "Capture price / volume-weighted price (trailing 12-month window)",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      caption = if_else(
        method == "including-curtailment" && tech %in% c("Wind", "Solar (Utility)"),
        curtailment_caption,
        NA_character_
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    base_theme

  print(p)
  ggsave(
    file.path(method_out_dirs[[method]], paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", tech), "_ratio.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
}
```

## Capture Ratio By Region (Across Technologies)

```{r}
plot_region_ratio_panels <- function(data, region, method, date_start = as.Date("2012-06-01")) {
  tech_focus <- c(
    "Battery (Discharging)",
    "Gas (OCGT)",
    "Gas (CCGT)",
    "Gas (Steam)",
    "Hydro",
    "Coal (Black)",
    "Coal (Brown)",
    "Wind",
    "Solar (Utility)",
    "Solar (Rooftop)"
  )

  df_region <- data %>%
    filter(Method == method, Region == region, Date >= date_start)

  ratio_df <- df_region %>%
    filter(Source %in% tech_focus, !is.na(CaptureRatio)) %>%
    mutate(
      line_alpha = if_else(
        Source %in% c("Wind", "Solar (Utility)", "Solar (Rooftop)"),
        1,
        0.35
      )
    )

  if (nrow(ratio_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  x_min <- min(ratio_df$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(ratio_df$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
  span_days <- as.numeric(x_max - x_min)
  margin_days <- max(30, ceiling(span_days * 0.08))
  y_min <- min(ratio_df$CaptureRatio, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(ratio_df$CaptureRatio, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lower <- min(-0.05, y_min * 1.1)
  y_upper <- max(1.0, y_max * 1.05)
  if (!is.finite(y_lower) || !is.finite(y_upper) || y_lower >= y_upper) {
    y_lower <- -0.05
    y_upper <- 1.5
  }
  region_label <- if_else(
    as.character(region) == "NEM",
    "the NEM",
    state_abbrev[[as.character(region)]]
  )

  labels_df <- ratio_df %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    slice_max(Date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  c_graph <- ggplot(ratio_df, aes(Date, CaptureRatio, colour = Source, alpha = line_alpha)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text(
      data = labels_df,
      aes(label = Source),
      hjust = 0,
      nudge_x = margin_days * 0.1,
      size = 3.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = tech_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max + days(margin_days)),
      breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), ceiling_date(x_max, "year"), by = "1 year"),
      date_labels = "'%y",
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_percent(),
      limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Capture price of generation technology as ratio of volume-weighted price in ", region_label),
      subtitle = "Trailing 12-month window",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 45, 5, 5)
    )

  combo_df <- df_region %>%
    group_by(Date) %>%
    summarise(
      renewable_gwh = sum(EnergyGWh[Source %in% c("Wind", "Solar (Utility)", "Solar (Rooftop)")], na.rm = TRUE),
      total_gwh = sum(EnergyGWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      penetration = if_else(total_gwh > 0, renewable_gwh / total_gwh, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      df_region %>% distinct(Date, BenchmarkPrice),
      by = "Date"
    )

  max_penetration <- max(combo_df$penetration, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_price <- max(combo_df$BenchmarkPrice, na.rm = TRUE)
  price_scale <- if_else(is.finite(max_price) && max_price > 0, max_penetration / max_price, 1)
  vre_col <- "#2E7D32"
  price_col <- "#111111"

  combined_graph <- ggplot(combo_df, aes(Date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = penetration, colour = "VRE share"), linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(aes(y = BenchmarkPrice * price_scale, colour = "Wholesale price"), linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max + days(margin_days)),
      breaks = seq(floor_date(x_min, "year"), ceiling_date(x_max, "year"), by = "1 year"),
      date_labels = "'%y",
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("VRE share" = vre_col, "Wholesale price" = price_col),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_percent(),
      limits = c(0, max_penetration * 1.1),
      expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
      name = "VRE share",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / price_scale, labels = scales::label_currency(suffix = " /MWh"), name = "Wholesale price")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Variable renewable energy penetration vs ", state_abbrev[[as.character(region)]], " wholesale price"),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      axis.title.y.left = element_text(colour = vre_col),
      axis.text.y.left = element_text(colour = vre_col),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = price_col),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(colour = price_col)
    )

  combined <- c_graph + combined_graph + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1.5))

  if (method == "including-curtailment" && any(ratio_df$Source %in% c("Wind", "Solar (Utility)"))) {
    combined <- combined + patchwork::plot_annotation(caption = curtailment_caption)
  }

  combined
}

for (method in names(method_out_dirs)) {
for (region in names(state_cols)) {
  p <- plot_region_ratio_panels(long_df_all, region, method)
  if (is.null(p)) next

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(method_out_dirs[[method]], paste0(state_abbrev[[region]], "_capture_ratio.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
}
```
